title: Plural personal partitive pronouns
focus: Use meitä, teitä and heitä for a plural personal object.

exercises.prompt: You = one person.Complete “You are waiting for us.” Odotat ____.
exercises.explanation: Use meitä, teitä or heitä as the plural personal object in this taught verb pattern. The standard written partitive form of me is meitä; learn this pronoun form directly.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Plural personal partitive pronouns: form or use confused

optionFeedback.meitä: Use meitä, teitä or heitä as the plural personal object in this taught verb pattern. The standard written partitive form of me is meitä; learn this pronoun form directly.
optionFeedback.me: me is not the required partitive form for this meaning. Use meitä, teitä or heitä as the plural personal object in this taught verb pattern.
optionFeedback.meidät: meidät does not express the requested case and number here. The standard written partitive form of me is meitä; learn this pronoun form directly.
